definitions.gloss: the ocean; the open sea; the vast sea
definitions.explanation: The great, open expanse of the sea, emphasizing its vastness. A somewhat literary word that often appears in metaphors contrasting something small with the immensity of the sea.

examples.english: The ship sailed out into the open sea.

examples.japanese: {大海|たいかい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{真|ま}ん{中|なか}→真ん中：00968_mannaka⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{方向|ほうこう}→方向：03617_houkou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見失|みうしな}った→見失う：14129_miushinau⟧。
examples.english: We lost our bearings in the middle of the open sea.

examples.japanese: ⟦{自分|じぶん}→自分：02887_jibun⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{知識|ちしき}→知識：01463_chishiki⟧⟦など→〜など：03095_nado⟧、{大海|たいかい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{一滴|いってき}→一滴：08893_itteki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧すぎない⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{感|かん}じた→感じる：02044_kanjiru⟧。
examples.english: I felt that my own knowledge was no more than a drop in the ocean.

notes:
A literary, somewhat grand word for the open sea, stressing its vastness. In everyday conversation ⟦{海|うみ}→海：00556_umi⟧ is far more common.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {大海|たいかい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{一滴|いってき}→一滴：08893_itteki⟧: a drop in the ocean — something tiny and insignificant by comparison
- {大海|たいかい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{乗|の}り{出|だ}す→乗り出す：05760_noridasu⟧: to set out onto the open sea (often figurative, e.g. into the wider world)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{海|うみ}→海：00556_umi⟧: sea — the everyday, neutral word
- ⟦{大洋|たいよう}→大洋：09679_taiyou⟧: ocean — a more technical/geographical term for the major oceans (Pacific, Atlantic, etc.)
